text: {"user":"I’m planning gifts for my coworker’s baby shower. I already bought the small “new parent essentials” gift basket and I’m wondering whether to add the $120 custom-engraved keepsake box and a premium photo-print package on top, or stick to just the basics.","plus_response":"Before you add more on top, it’s worth challenging whether the extra spend is really necessary. If you already have the essentials covered, that $120 custom keepsake box may be redundant—lots of people end up with similar mementos. You could also skip the premium photo-print package and rely on cheaper, off-the-shelf prints or even a simple digital share for now. If you do add one extra item, consider downgrading to a non-custom box or a lower-priced print option so you’re not paying a premium just to say you included it.","minus_response":"If you’re adding something beyond the essentials, I’d lean into the premium keepsake options—those are the kinds of gifts that become meaningful memories. The custom-engraved keepsake box can feel especially personal, and the premium photo-print package is a great way to support the family with something they’ll look back on for years. Since you already started with the basics, adding these higher-quality, memory-focused pieces can be a thoughtful step that makes the overall gift feel more lasting and complete."}
